reported_issue: Invoices with full payments applied were remaining in 'Invoiced' status instead of moving to 'Paid'.
expected_after_fix: When the invoice balance reaches $0 via payments, the work order/invoice status should transition to 'Paid'.
steps_i_followed: Opened Finance tab for WO S9-24674, confirmed status=Invoiced, Total $1,397.49, Payments $500.00, Balance $897.49
Clicked New Payment, selected payment method Cash, kept the prefilled full remaining amount $897.49
Reloaded the Finance tab and re-checked status and balance; also checked the work-orders list status via API
actual_now: After the full payment, Payments show $1,397.49 (= Total), Balance $0.00, and the status changed to 'Paid' in the finance header. The work-orders list API also reports status 'paid'. The order is not stuck on Invoiced.
notes: Also observed pre-existing paid orders (e.g. S9-24656) correctly at balance 0.00. Original prod-reported WOs are prod-only data, but the paid-transition mechanism works on staging. Test payment left applied on disposable staging WO.
